property.statement: A local catalog stage and its warm/fresh consumers may reuse or expose a generation only while the current selected producer inputs and required output inventory match the persisted content basis; unchanged content retains a positive skip.
property.acceptance_signal: In the real sync producer, unchanged inputs retain a current receipt and skip harvest/normalize/merge/graph/benchmark without refetch. A same-ID source registry byte mutation with path, size and mtime preserved makes the recomputed basis stale, blocks stage skip and warm/fresh reader admission, and after recomputation changes both report basis and benchmark inventory. A removal control proves the reader would expose the stale plan if its currentness admission were bypassed.
property.consumer_surface: Catalog stage checkpoint/reuse, warm and fresh Fabric RetrievalService, Catalog report/publication readers, WVS loaders/harvester cache, connector session cache, and existing Catalog resource/read-API facades.
property.authority_scope: Proposal for the original I1 author task exit only. No formal LA-041 closure, G code acceptance, production-source freshness, selected-scope v2 semantics or global source/backend freeze is claimed.

whole_property_composition.generic_wvs_join: WVS registry and optional variable-catalog bytes are selected material snapshots in the same generic producer-config basis that feeds run_signature and every content-bound stage input basis. WVS loader and harvester caches key parsed content by those snapshots. The WVS byte-drift tests prove warm bulk rows/catalog metadata change and the signature changes; therefore the generic stage reuse join is present without a WVS-specific enumerated join. This is complete-by-construction for the bounded currentness property; no giant combined test is required.
deciding_invariants: Input identity and output inventory are both required for stage reuse; metadata-only path/size/mtime is insufficient.
Exact same-stat byte drift must invalidate; unchanged bytes must still produce a useful skip.
The producer signature and consumer cache keys must use the same effective material snapshot.
Reader currentness controls actual fetch-plan admission, not only a marker or exit code.
